name: Doubting Disease
source:
You're ten years old. You're sick with a fever. Your parents will know what to do, but how will you get to them?

A mysterious figure guards their door, and before you pass, he wants you to wash your hands. Over and over. He can't be satisfied.

How will you get help? Are you even awake?

[From [url=https://shaylyn-k-melin.itch.io/doubting-disease]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你十岁了。你发烧了。你的父母会知道该怎么做，但你怎样才能找到他们呢？

一个神秘人物把守着他们的门，在你经过之前，他要你洗手。一遍又一遍。他不能满足。

你将如何获得帮助？你还醒着吗？

[来自[url=https://shaylyn-k-melin.itch.io/doubting-disease]Itch.io[/url]]
